verse.verse_1: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning
verse.verse_2: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah Amshaj, in order to try him, so, We made him hearer and seer.
verse.verse_3: Verily, We guided him to the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
verse.verse_4: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and Sa`ir.
verse.verse_5: Verily, the Abrar (righteous believers) shall drink of a cup mixed with Kafur.
verse.verse_6: A spring wherefrom the servants of Allah will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.
verse.verse_7: They fulfill (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.
verse.verse_8: And they give food, inspite of their love for it, to the poor, the orphan and the captive,
verse.verse_9: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allah's Face only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you."
verse.verse_10: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day that is `Abus and Qamtarir."
verse.verse_11: So, Allah saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.
verse.verse_12: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.
verse.verse_13: Reclining therein on raised couches, they will see there neither the excessive heat, nor the excessive cold.
verse.verse_14: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.
verse.verse_15: And among them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal --
verse.verse_16: (Qawarir) Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof.
verse.verse_17: And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabil (ginger),
verse.verse_19: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.
verse.verse_20: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.
verse.verse_21: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and Istabraq. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
verse.verse_22: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavor has been accepted."
verse.verse_23: Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to you by stages.
verse.verse_24: Therefore be patient with constancy to the command of your Lord, and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.
verse.verse_25: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon.
verse.verse_26: And during the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him a long night through.
verse.verse_27: Verily, these love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day.
verse.verse_28: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong build. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.
verse.verse_29: Verily, this is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
verse.verse_30: But you cannot will, unless Allah wills. Verily, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.
verse.verse_31: He will admit to His mercy whom He wills and as for the wrongdoers -- He has prepared a painful torment.
